message: I stepped off a curb yesterday and turned my ankle. It is puffy and purple on the outside. I can put a little weight on it if I hold the wall. Is this something I can manage at home?

I twisted my ankle this morning. I can walk four steps, but touching the very tip of the outside ankle bone causes sharp pain. There is swelling over that bone. My foot is warm and I can feel and move my toes.

I landed badly on my ankle about two hours ago. I could not take four steps right after it happened, and I still cannot take four steps now. The pain is around both ankle bones. It is swollen but not crooked.
After a hard fall my ankle is bent at a strange angle. The foot below it feels cold and numb, and I cannot wiggle my toes. This started 20 minutes ago.

An urgent care clinician examined my twisted ankle yesterday, said the x-rays showed no fracture, and gave me a sprain care plan. Today the pain and swelling are both better. I can walk normally, and have no new pain, numbness or skin change. I just want to know whether I can keep following that plan.

I rolled my ankle playing tennis. I do not have numbness, and my foot is not cold. But I could not walk four steps when it happened and still cannot now because of ankle pain. Does the lack of numbness mean I can stay home?

It has been ten days since I turned my ankle. Swelling is a little better but I still limp and cannot finish my usual short walk. Nobody has examined it. I have been using a wrap and resting. Should I keep doing the same thing?

I was examined for a mild ankle sprain this afternoon. The clinician checked the ankle and foot bones, said imaging was not indicated, and watched me walk. I have mild soreness only, no worsening swelling and no new symptoms. They advised a cold pack; can I put a towel between the pack and my skin?

For six weeks it has taken me two hours to fall asleep most nights even though I have enough time in bed. I am exhausted during the day and my work is suffering. I have cut out afternoon coffee but it has not helped. What should I do next?

I slept poorly for two nights while finishing a deadline. The deadline is over and I slept normally last night. I feel well during the day and am not asking for medicine. Can I return to my usual bedtime routine?

I have slept about two hours total in four days but feel unusually powerful and full of energy. My family says I talk much faster than usual. I have spent most of my savings online and cannot slow down. This has never happened before.
I cannot sleep and I plan to take all the pills on my bedside table tonight to end my life. I am alone and have the pills next to me right now.

My partner says I snore loudly and repeatedly stop breathing while asleep. For two months I have woken unrefreshed and struggled to stay alert at work. I have not fallen asleep driving and I am not having breathing trouble while awake. Can you help me work out why?

I need a refill of the sleep medicine my clinician has prescribed for the past year. My dose and symptoms are unchanged, I have no new symptoms, and I have three tablets left. Can someone review the refill?

I stayed up late watching a movie last night and feel a little tired today. Before that I was sleeping normally, and I have no other symptoms. I do not want sleeping tablets. Would returning to my normal sleep schedule be reasonable?

Since starting the prednisone my clinician prescribed a week ago I can barely sleep and feel jittery. I am tired rather than energized, can manage my usual activities, and have no thoughts of harming myself. Should my medicine be reviewed?
For the last 20 minutes I have had heavy pressure in the middle of my chest with sweating and nausea. It started while I was sitting down and has not stopped. I am 58.
My right arm suddenly became weak and my speech was slurred about half an hour ago. It lasted ten minutes and now seems normal again. Since it went away, can I just monitor it?

My usual asthma preventer inhaler is nearly empty and I need the same prescription renewed. My breathing is normal, I am not wheezing, and I have not needed my rescue inhaler more often. Could the clinician review a refill?
I am contacting you for an asthma inhaler refill, but right now I am very short of breath and can only say a few words before stopping for air. My rescue inhaler has not helped.

My usual spring allergies started yesterday: sneezing, itchy eyes and a clear runny nose after gardening. The symptoms are mild. I have no fever, wheeze, breathing difficulty or facial swelling. I am only asking about rinsing off pollen and keeping the windows closed.

I am 26 weeks pregnant. My ankle sprain was checked last week and is getting better, but I want to take ibuprofen for the remaining soreness. I have not taken any yet. Do I need someone to check whether that is appropriate?

An article I read mentioned chest pressure, sweating and weakness in one arm. Those are examples from the article, not symptoms I have. I have only a mild runny nose for two days, no fever, no trouble breathing, and I otherwise feel well. I am asking about rest and fluids.
I am about nine weeks pregnant and suddenly have strong pain low on one side of my belly. I feel faint and have pain at the tip of my shoulder. It started about an hour ago.
